_about: Advisories the weekly dependency audit (scripts/dependency-audit/report.mjs) treats as dismissed. Only a critical advisory fails the job. Each entry needs the GitHub advisory id, the package, the severity it was reviewed at, a reason and a review date (YYYY-MM-DD). An entry dismisses the advisory only as it was reviewed: at or below that severity (a re-scored advisory fails the job again), only until the review date, and, with "untilPatched": true (the reason is that no fixed version exists), only while the advisory lists no patched version. Remove an entry when the audit stops reporting it.
